gancho: Hiʻiaka finally brings Lohiʻau to the rim of Kīlauea, and in full view of Pele and her court, she does the one thing Pele forbade. Pele's fire turns Lohiʻau to stone, Hiʻiaka digs down toward the sea in her grief, and Pele's brother, sailing a seashell canoe, catches a lost spirit. The finale of Season Two. Based on N. B. Emerson, Pele and Hiiaka (1915), W. D. Westervelt (1916) and Martha Beckwith (1940).
siguiente: Hawaiʻi Loa and the Star Navigator
